confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of southern Italian tourist-city pricing; no live listings or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant and bar anchors are moderately reliable. Accommodation anchors are less certain because July is peak season in Lecce and rates vary with events, room type, and the imposta di soggiorno tourist tax. Cocktail and wine anchors are set relative to the local beer and restaurant price level because direct knowledge is weaker. FX: the 0.6955 USD_PER_AUD figure for 2026-10-15 was taken from search-result summaries of RBA exchange-rate pages; the RBA F11.1 table itself was not opened directly. A 2026-10-16 figure reported by a third party was not used because it could not be verified against the RBA.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced as a mid-sized southern Italian art city with strong July tourist demand, comparable to Bari, Matera, and Siracusa in the summer season.
